lines.t: The skies are quiet no trumpet sounds
Feet on the earth but my heart's unbound
I look for a sign a spark a flame
A whisper of hope in Your holy name
Every tear will fade away
Every shadow bows to day
YahuShua take us home
Through the fire through the storm
We are waiting hearts are worn
YahuShua take us home
The night is long but the dawn will break
Your light will shine through the darkest ache
We walk through the valley we carry the weight
But I know You’ll open the pearly gates
Chains will fall the lost will sing
At the coming of the King
YahuShua take us home
Through the fire through the storm
We are waiting hearts are worn
YahuShua take us home
